profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer | Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, AI/ML | AWS Certified | Cloud-Native & Scalable Solutions Expert
profile.summary:
I am a results-driven Lead Software Engineer with over 10 years of experience designing, building, and optimizing scalable, high-performance applications that align with business goals. I specialize in software architecture, system modernization, DevOps practices, and cross-functional team leadership, with a passion for driving technical excellence and continuous improvement.

While my core strength lies in delivering robust enterprise solutions, I am passionate about staying at the forefront of technology and driving innovation through AI/ML fundamentals, AWS architecture, and cloud-native development, with the goal of applying these skills to innovative, real-world problems.

I specialize in bridging the gap between technical execution and strategic business needs, applying deep knowledge of software architecture, system performance, and team leadership to deliver impactful solutions. Whether building from the ground up or modernizing legacy platforms, I focus on future-proofing systems while fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

I am looking to connect with professionals and organizations who are leveraging AI, ML, and cloud computing to reimagine software and business processes. Whether it’s innovation initiatives, collaborative projects, or knowledge sharing — I’m excited to be part of the journey.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Contribute to developing features that migrate the Datto RMM legacy platform to the new UI and improve platform stability, performance, and scalability
• Support the migration and implementation of Datto RMM integrations, including Autotask PSA, to the new UI platform
• Participate in sprint planning, estimation, and execution to deliver ongoing project milestones
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Engineering, Support, DevOps, and Implementation to ensure successful project delivery
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Boot · Microservices · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Amazon Dynamodb · Docker · Redis · MySQL · Amzon SQS · Groovy · Grails · GraphQL · Amazon S3 · Hibernate · REST APIs
